data.claim: Idempotency constrains the operation's effect on state, while safety constrains the operation's effect on correctness under retries. An append-only event log requires safety: writers must ensure that duplicate appends—inevitable under at-least-once delivery—do not corrupt deterministic replay, achievable via content-addressable or sequence-numbered appends that make duplicates detectable even though the raw append remains non-idempotent.
